CG02 may use Cameron visible two silver dogtags only, or visible closed holster body; holster contents and weapon model unknown, no invented P90 or held firearm.

All fifteen exact submitted strings are retained from actual live calls and byte-compared to the selected prompt files, including terminal LF; each own actual returned output_hint names its selected native.

CG03 required genuine new renders for smooth nonpixel style and cropped main ring; CG10 genuine reprise reveals both complete boots; CG11 genuine reprise keeps main held map complete. All real drafts retained.
Source-hidden hands/palms, fine clasp/back attachments and holster contents are interpreted ordinary visible geometry, never exact hidden authority.
